1.text: Rush hour in a provincial town is certainly not so busy as in London, but even so there are plenty of people moving about.
1.lessonText: Rush hour in a provincial town is certainly not so busy as in London, but even so there are plenty of people moving about.
functions: Rush hour in a provincial town

clauses.text: Rush hour in a provincial town is certainly not so busy as in London,
but even so there are plenty of people moving about.

notes: as in London 是压缩的比较补充，未写出限定分句。moving about 为分词后置修饰 people，不是谓语。
as in London 是比较省略短语；moving about 是分词后置修饰，不另造有限定谓语的从句。

2.text: Long, patient queues wait wearily for buses.
2.lessonText: Long, patient queues wait wearily for buses.

clauses.text: Long, patient queues wait wearily for buses.

notes: queues 代指排队的人，才可承受 patient、wearily 的人的特征；属于转喻。for buses 不是目的不定式。

3.text: Never-ending lines of cars are checked while red traffic lights change to green.
3.lessonText: Never-ending lines of cars are checked while red traffic lights change to green.

clauses.text: Never-ending lines of cars are checked while red traffic lights change to green.
while red traffic lights change to green.

notes: checked 在此是“被阻止前进”，不是检查车辆。while 描写等待灯色转换的时段；原文不改成另一连词。

4.text: Thousands of people are packed tightly in trains, the men's faces buried in their evening papers while women try in vain to knit.
4.lessonText: Thousands of people are packed tightly in trains, the men's faces buried in their evening papers while women try in vain to knit.

clauses.text: Thousands of people are packed tightly in trains, the men's faces buried in their evening papers while women try in vain to knit.
the men's faces buried in their evening papers
while women try in vain to knit.

notes: faces 是 buried 的逻辑主语；独立主格没有限定谓语，不能把 buried 当过去式。while 引出的从句另有主语 women 与限定谓语 try。
the men’s faces buried… 按 Absolute construction 处理，buried 不属于有限定谓语；while 从句主要表达同时发生的活动，同时带有男女对照意味。

5.text: In a slow train it may well be an hour's journey to their station.
5.lessonText: In a slow train it may well be an hour's journey to their station.
functions: an hour's journey to their station.

clauses.text: In a slow train it may well be an hour's journey to their station.

notes: may well 表很可能，不是“也许很好”。it 泛指这趟旅程；an hour's journey 用所有格表示历时。

6.text: James Saxon is in his usual comfortable corner, quietly smoking a cigarette.
6.lessonText: James Saxon is in his usual comfortable corner, quietly smoking a cigarette.

clauses.text: James Saxon is in his usual comfortable corner, quietly smoking a cigarette.

notes: smoking 的逻辑主语是 James Saxon，表示伴随动作；is 与 smoking 被完整地点结构隔开，不能简单拼成同一个进行时谓语。
is 是地点补足前的系动词；quietly smoking 为补充性分词结构，不与 is 跨越地点成分拼成进行时。

7.text: When he is travelling by train at this time, he always reaches the station at ten past five by the station clock, but he never catches the 5:14 train.
7.lessonText: When he is travelling by train at this time, he always reaches the station at ten past five by the station clock, but he never catches the 5:14 train.

clauses.text: When he is travelling by train at this time, he always reaches the station at ten past five by the station clock,
When he is travelling by train at this time,
but he never catches the 5:14 train.

notes: by the station clock 意为以车站时钟为准。but 连接两个主句；when 从句作习惯性出行的时间背景。

8.text: Instead he travels by the train which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.
8.lessonText: Instead he travels by the train which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.
functions: so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.

clauses.text: Instead he travels by the train which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five so as to be sure of getting his corner seat.
which leaves at twenty-four minutes past five

notes: which 指 train，作 leaves 主语。so as to 表目的，不是 so that 从句。be sure of 后接 getting。
which 定语从句在 five 后结束；so as to… 表达乘此班车的目的，不纳入定语从句。

9.text: There are no first-class compartments or reserved seats on this train.
9.lessonText: There are no first-class compartments or reserved seats on this train.
functions: no first-class compartments or reserved seats

clauses.text: There are no first-class compartments or reserved seats on this train.

notes: no 的否定范围覆盖 or 连接的两项。reserved 为过去分词定语，不是句子的独立谓语。

10.text: He appears to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper and ignores the hurrying crowds.
10.lessonText: He appears to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper and ignores the hurrying crowds.
functions: to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper

clauses.text: He appears to be absorbed in the sports news on the back page of his paper and ignores the hurrying crowds.

notes: appears 和 ignores 共用主语。to be absorbed 是不定式，不是限定从句；appears 提醒读者这只是外部观察。

11.text: Facing him this evening there is a Finnish youth of eighteen, Matti Arpola.
11.lessonText: Facing him this evening there is a Finnish youth of eighteen, Matti Arpola.

clauses.text: Facing him this evening there is a Finnish youth of eighteen, Matti Arpola.

notes: Facing him 描写位置，逻辑上对应后面的 youth；不宜按通常悬垂分词规则误说 there 在面对他。Matti Arpola 为同位语。

12.text: This is his first visit to England, though he already knows Geoffrey, the eldest son of the Jackson family, with whom he is going to stay.
12.lessonText: This is his first visit to England, though he already knows Geoffrey, the eldest son of the Jackson family, with whom he is going to stay.
functions: the eldest son of the Jackson family,

clauses.text: This is his first visit to England, though he already knows Geoffrey, the eldest son of the Jackson family, with whom he is going to stay.
though he already knows Geoffrey, the eldest son of the Jackson family, with whom he is going to stay.
with whom he is going to stay.

notes: with whom 形式上最自然地回指 Geoffrey；也可以在“到 Jackson family 家中借住”的语境下理解为与家庭相关。单凭本句不能绝对排除后一种关联。
with whom 采用承接 Geoffrey 的分析，并嵌套在 though 从句内；上下文也允许理解为住在 Jackson 家。is going to stay 按将来谓语链展示。

13.text: As there are several people standing, James Saxon is the only person he can see clearly.
13.lessonText: As there are several people standing, James Saxon is the only person he can see clearly.

clauses.text: As there are several people standing, James Saxon is the only person he can see clearly.
As there are several people standing,
he can see clearly.

notes: as 表原因。standing 后置修饰 people；person 后省略关系词，在 see 后作宾语。
he can see clearly 为省略关系宾语 that / whom 的定语从句；standing 是 people 的非谓语修饰。

14.text: Matti decides that he is probably a typical Englishman, and he observes James carefully.
14.lessonText: Matti decides that he is probably a typical Englishman, and he observes James carefully.

clauses.text: Matti decides that he is probably a typical Englishman,
that he is probably a typical Englishman,
and he observes James carefully.

notes: 第一处 he 指 James，and 后 he 指 Matti。probably 标出推测性，后文都是人物凭外观作出的猜想。

15.text: "Can he really be typical?" he thinks.
15.lessonText: "Can he really be typical?" he thinks.

clauses.text: "Can he really be typical?"
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

clauses.text: he thinks.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: 引语内部为情态动词前置的疑问句；he thinks 是报告句。与第一篇直接引语一样单独标注，不强行把引号内问句当普通 that 宾语从句。
直接引语与 he thinks 分别用 Quoted main clause / Reporting clause，保留问句倒装及原标点。

16.text: "He has an umbrella, neatly rolled, but no bowler hat; in fact, no hat at all.
16.lessonText: "He has an umbrella, neatly rolled, but no bowler hat; in fact, no hat at all.
functions: in fact, no hat at all.

clauses.text: "He has an umbrella, neatly rolled, but no bowler hat; in fact, no hat at all.

notes: neatly rolled 修饰 umbrella。but no bowler hat 与 an umbrella 对照，共享 has；分号后的名词片段没有新限定谓语。
but 连接宾语，in fact 后是对 no bowler hat 的省略补充；neatly rolled 为分词修饰，不补造新的限定谓语。

17.text: Of course, he is reading about cricket and he is reserved and not interested in other people.
17.lessonText: Of course, he is reading about cricket and he is reserved and not interested in other people.
functions: reserved and not interested in other people.

clauses.text: Of course, he is reading about cricket
and he is reserved and not interested in other people.

notes: 两个 he is… 构成并列主句；第二句的 reserved 和 interested 是形容词性表语。Of course 体现 Matti 自以为是的确信。

18.text: But he is only of average height and his hair is not fair, but as dark as that of an Italian, and curly, with almost no parting.
18.lessonText: But he is only of average height and his hair is not fair, but as dark as that of an Italian, and curly, with almost no parting.
functions: not fair, but as dark as that of an Italian, and curly,

clauses.text: But he is only of average height
and his hair is not fair, but as dark as that of an Italian, and curly, with almost no parting.

notes: of average height 作表语。that 代替 hair，避免与一个人本身比较；fair 指发色浅。民族外貌描述是人物的刻板印象，不是事实规律。

19.text: He is not smoking a pipe, and although we foreigners think that a real Englishman ought to have a moustache, he is clean-shaven.
19.lessonText: He is not smoking a pipe, and although we foreigners think that a real Englishman ought to have a moustache, he is clean-shaven.

clauses.text: He is not smoking a pipe,
and although we foreigners think that a real Englishman ought to have a moustache, he is clean-shaven.
although we foreigners think that a real Englishman ought to have a moustache,
that a real Englishman ought to have a moustache,

notes: that 从句嵌在 although 从句内。foreigners 与 we 同位；clean-shaven 是复合形容词。ought to 所表达的是人物预期。
although 让步从句内嵌 that 宾语从句；is 与 smoking 之间的 not 单独标为 Negation。

clauses.text: His nose is slightly crooked.

notes: slightly 修饰 crooked 的程度。crooked 在此外形义，没有指他不诚实。

21.text: What a serious face he has!
21.lessonText: What a serious face he has!

clauses.text: What a serious face he has!

notes: What + a + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语 的感叹结构；还原为 He has a serious face，不做一般疑问倒装。
What a serious face 是前置感叹宾语；he has 仍为主谓顺序。

22.text: He is frowning a little, but the eyes beneath his worried-looking forehead are sincere and honest.
22.lessonText: He is frowning a little, but the eyes beneath his worried-looking forehead are sincere and honest.
functions: the eyes beneath his worried-looking forehead

clauses.text: He is frowning a little,
but the eyes beneath his worried-looking forehead are sincere and honest.

notes: beneath… 修饰 eyes，主句谓语为 are。sincere 与 honest 并列作表语；作者呈现的是 Matti 的观感。

23.text: I don't think he is intelligent.
23.lessonText: I don't think he is intelligent.

clauses.text: I don't think he is intelligent.
he is intelligent.

notes: 典型否定转移：I don't think P 通常表达“我认为非 P”。宾语从句省略 that，不是两个独立主句。

clauses.text: "His clothes are anything but smart.

notes: clothes 是复数名词。anything but 加强否定 smart；此处 smart 指衣着整洁漂亮，不指智力。

25.text: In fact, they are rather old, though well-brushed.
25.lessonText: In fact, they are rather old, though well-brushed.

clauses.text: In fact, they are rather old, though well-brushed.
though well-brushed.

notes: though well-brushed 可还原 though they are well-brushed；原文未写限定谓语，按同一分流口径归简单句并提示省略。
though well-brushed 使用 Reduced concessive clause，省略 they are 仅在提示中列出。

26.text: Even though he is not wearing a wedding ring, he is probably married, with perhaps three children.
26.lessonText: Even though he is not wearing a wedding ring, he is probably married, with perhaps three children.

clauses.text: Even though he is not wearing a wedding ring, he is probably married, with perhaps three children.
Even though he is not wearing a wedding ring,

notes: even though 引入已观察到的事实，与假设 even if 区别。probably、perhaps 表推测；孩子数量来自想象。

27.text: His gloves are fur-lined and his trousers well pressed.
27.lessonText: His gloves are fur-lined and his trousers well pressed.

clauses.text: His gloves are fur-lined
and his trousers well pressed.
clauses.label: Elliptical main clause

notes: 第二项有自己的主语 trousers，省略了重复的 are，属于并列分句的省略；不是第一项的并列表语。
第二分句省略 are；well pressed 为表语，不标成原文已有的限定谓语。

28.text: He keeps far too many things in his pockets, so his suit looks badly out of shape.
28.lessonText: He keeps far too many things in his pockets, so his suit looks badly out of shape.

clauses.text: He keeps far too many things in his pockets,
so his suit looks badly out of shape.

notes: so 连接结果主句。far 修饰 too，加强“过多”；looks 为系动词，后接 out of shape 描写状态。

29.text: What dull, old-fashioned leather shoes he is wearing!
29.lessonText: What dull, old-fashioned leather shoes he is wearing!

clauses.text: What dull, old-fashioned leather shoes he is wearing!

notes: shoes 为复数，因此 What 后不加 a。保持主语 he 在谓语前的感叹句语序。

30.text: His briefcase is old too and bulging, so that the zip-fastener does not close properly.
30.lessonText: His briefcase is old too and bulging, so that the zip-fastener does not close properly.

clauses.text: His briefcase is old too and bulging, so that the zip-fastener does not close properly.
so that the zip-fastener does not close properly.

notes: so that 在此表达结果，不是“为了拉不上”。close 为不及物用法，主语拉链虽非施事，也不必改成被动。
so that 此处表达箱子鼓胀导致拉链关不上的结果，使用中性 Result clause，区别于 Purpose clause。

31.text: There are the initials J. S. on it.
31.lessonText: There are the initials J. S. on it.

clauses.text: There are the initials J. S. on it.

notes: J. S. 是姓名缩写，句点不另外分句。the initials 是复数，所以用 are；it 指 briefcase。
J. S. 是姓名首字母缩写，保持同一句，不按缩写句点拆开。

clauses.text: Is his name John Smith?

notes: be 动词疑问句，is 移到主语前。仅凭首字母猜名字，正是人物推测超出证据的一步。

33.text: "I think he is probably an office clerk or a shop assistant.
33.lessonText: "I think he is probably an office clerk or a shop assistant.
functions: an office clerk or a shop assistant.

clauses.text: "I think he is probably an office clerk or a shop assistant.
he is probably an office clerk or a shop assistant.

notes: or 连接从句中的两个表语名词。probably 表可能性，不是已知职业。

34.text: Does he look like a teacher, though?
34.lessonText: Does he look like a teacher, though?

clauses.text: Does he look like a teacher, though?

notes: 句末 though 为副词“不过”，没有引导从句。Does 后 look 用原形；like 是介词。
句尾 though 为转折副词，不建立让步从句。

35.text: Anyhow, he lives with a plain wife and five children in a small worker's house with a tiny garden, where he spends his leisure time digging and weeding and mowing the lawn, or painting the tool shed.
35.lessonText: Anyhow, he lives with a plain wife and five children in a small worker's house with a tiny garden, where he spends his leisure time digging and weeding and mowing the lawn, or painting the tool shed.
functions: with a plain wife and five children
in a small worker's house with a tiny garden,
digging and weeding and mowing the lawn, or painting the tool shed.

clauses.text: Anyhow, he lives with a plain wife and five children in a small worker's house with a tiny garden, where he spends his leisure time digging and weeding and mowing the lawn, or painting the tool shed.
where he spends his leisure time digging and weeding and mowing the lawn, or painting the tool shed.

notes: where 主要指花园这个活动地点。spend time doing 的四项 -ing 共享 spend；所谓妻儿和活动都属于 Matti 的想象，孩子数已从三变五。
where 从句修饰 garden；digging、weeding、mowing、painting 均是 spends time 的非谓语补足，不另标成限定谓语。

36.text: But tonight, first he is helping his wife to put the children to bed and then he is taking her to the cinema as this is payday.
36.lessonText: But tonight, first he is helping his wife to put the children to bed and then he is taking her to the cinema as this is payday.
functions: to put the children to bed

clauses.text: But tonight, first he is helping his wife to put the children to bed
and then he is taking her to the cinema as this is payday.
as this is payday.

notes: 两处进行时被用来想象当晚安排。as 表原因；help his wife to put… 中 wife 是 put 的逻辑主语。

37.text: Or is he visiting the local pub?
37.lessonText: Or is he visiting the local pub?

clauses.text: Or is he visiting the local pub?

notes: 一般疑问句用 be 前置。Or 在句首连接话语中的另一猜测，不代表本条音频内出现两个主句。

38.text: Does he drink whisky (I believe most Englishmen do) or does he prefer beer?
38.lessonText: Does he drink whisky (I believe most Englishmen do) or does he prefer beer?

clauses.text: Does he drink whisky (I believe most Englishmen do)
(I believe most Englishmen do)
most Englishmen do
or does he prefer beer?

notes: or 连接两个问句。括号内 believe 后省略 that；do 替代 drink whisky。国籍与饮品的联系是角色偏见，不作为文化事实讲授。
括号为 Parenthetical comment；内部 believe 带省略 that 的 Object clause，do 代替 drink whisky。外层两个疑问主句各有独立谓语。

39.text: I am sure he very much likes a cup of tea.
39.lessonText: I am sure he very much likes a cup of tea.

clauses.text: I am sure he very much likes a cup of tea.
he very much likes a cup of tea.

notes: that 从句是 sure 的内容补足，不宜简单把 sure 当动词。very much 修饰 likes，而非 cup。
he very much likes… 为形容词 sure 的 Content clause 补足，不标为 am 的宾语。

40.text: He seems quite energetic, but his complexion is pale and he is very thin.
40.lessonText: He seems quite energetic, but his complexion is pale and he is very thin.

clauses.text: He seems quite energetic,
but his complexion is pale
and he is very thin.

notes: 三个限定主句。seems 标记观感；苍白、瘦并不能证明人物贫困。

41.text: Does he find it difficult to satisfy the needs of his miserable wife and seven unfortunate children?
41.lessonText: Does he find it difficult to satisfy the needs of his miserable wife and seven unfortunate children?
functions: to satisfy the needs of his miserable wife and seven unfortunate children?

clauses.text: Does he find it difficult to satisfy the needs of his miserable wife and seven unfortunate children?

notes: find it difficult to do：it 是形式宾语，difficult 为宾补。to satisfy 没有限定谓语；句子长但按本课标准仍属简单句。孩子已被想象成七个。
it 为形式宾语，difficult 为 Object complement；to satisfy… 为后置不定式宾语，不是有限定谓语从句。

clauses.text: Poor fellow!
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: 没有限定谓语，是独立感叹用的名词短语。不能硬补一个不存在的主谓结构；也不把人物的怜悯当客观处境。
Poor fellow! 是名词感叹片段，使用中性 Sentence fragment，不增加虚构谓语。

clauses.text: I am sorry for him."

notes: be sorry for 表同情；be sorry about 表为某事遗憾，be sorry to do 表遗憾做某事。

44.text: At last, shortly after a quarter past six by Matti's watch, the train reaches Lakewell Junction, and Matti immediately sees Geoffrey waiting for him.
44.lessonText: At last, shortly after a quarter past six by Matti's watch, the train reaches Lakewell Junction, and Matti immediately sees Geoffrey waiting for him.
functions: shortly after a quarter past six by Matti's watch,

clauses.text: At last, shortly after a quarter past six by Matti's watch, the train reaches Lakewell Junction,
and Matti immediately sees Geoffrey waiting for him.

notes: see Geoffrey waiting 为感知动词＋宾语＋-ing。him 指 Matti；by Matti's watch 表按他的手表时间。

clauses.text: They greet each other.

notes: each other 为相互代词。greet 直接接人，不用 greet to。

46.text: At first Matti cannot find his ticket, but it is discovered in his bulging coat pocket.
46.lessonText: At first Matti cannot find his ticket, but it is discovered in his bulging coat pocket.

clauses.text: At first Matti cannot find his ticket,
but it is discovered in his bulging coat pocket.

notes: it 指 ticket；第二句被动未说明发现者。Matti 自己也有鼓胀口袋，反照他刚才对 James 的判断。

47.text: He gives it up to the ticket-collector and the two boys go off to find Geoffrey's father's car.
47.lessonText: He gives it up to the ticket-collector and the two boys go off to find Geoffrey's father's car.

clauses.text: He gives it up to the ticket-collector
and the two boys go off to find Geoffrey's father's car.

notes: give it up 在这里指交出票，不是放弃某项事业。to find 表目的；连续所有格说明车属于谁。
gives…up 是分离短语动词，up 也使用主句谓语色；to the ticket-collector 为接受者补足。

48.text: Near it there stands another car, a magnificent Rolls-Royce, and a handsome, uniformed chauffeur is holding the door open while James Saxon steps in.
48.lessonText: Near it there stands another car, a magnificent Rolls-Royce, and a handsome, uniformed chauffeur is holding the door open while James Saxon steps in.

clauses.text: Near it there stands another car, a magnificent Rolls-Royce,
and a handsome, uniformed chauffeur is holding the door open while James Saxon steps in.
while James Saxon steps in.

notes: there stands 类似存在句，another car 是实义主语。open 为 door 的宾补，说明门保持打开状态。while 表同时发生。
there stands 为存在结构；open 为宾语 the door 的补足，while 从句表示同时发生的动作。

clauses.text: "Who is that?"
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

clauses.text: Matti asks.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: 引语自身为特殊疑问句；报告句说明说话者。作为“引语＋报告句”单独标示。

50.text: "Why is he getting into that car?
50.lessonText: "Why is he getting into that car?

clauses.text: "Why is he getting into that car?

notes: Why 询问原因；is 前置形成疑问，getting into 表进入车内。

clauses.text: Where does he live?

notes: does 已承担时态与单数一致，后面 live 用原形，不再加 -s。

52.text: He looks like a poorly-paid clerk or a workman."
52.lessonText: He looks like a poorly-paid clerk or a workman."
functions: like a poorly-paid clerk or a workman."

clauses.text: He looks like a poorly-paid clerk or a workman."

notes: like 后两个名词由 or 连接。poorly-paid 修饰 clerk，指工资低；look like 只表达外观印象。

53.text: Geoffrey laughs loudly as if this is a good joke.
53.lessonText: Geoffrey laughs loudly as if this is a good joke.

clauses.text: Geoffrey laughs loudly as if this is a good joke.
as if this is a good joke.

notes: as if 引导方式比较；原文用直陈式 is，并非所有 as if 后都必须用虚拟式。
as if 引导比较／方式从句，沿用 Comparative clause 的既有绿色；不是条件 if 从句。

54.text: "That is Sir James Saxon," he replies.
54.lessonText: "That is Sir James Saxon," he replies.

clauses.text: "That is Sir James Saxon,"
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

clauses.text: he replies.
clauses.label: Reporting clause

notes: Sir 是爵士等称号，在这里不是简单的称呼“先生”。直接引语与报告句分别辨认。

55.text: He has a fortune of around two million pounds, and controls forty-two factories in this area alone.
55.lessonText: He has a fortune of around two million pounds, and controls forty-two factories in this area alone.
functions: a fortune of around two million pounds,

clauses.text: He has a fortune of around two million pounds, and controls forty-two factories in this area alone.

notes: has 和 controls 共用 He。alone 后置修饰范围 in this area，意为单是此地，不是他孤独地掌管工厂。
has 与 controls 共享 He，在同一主句内并列。

56.text: He is a bachelor who lives in a fourth-storey luxury flat, so, if he feels like it, he can go off to the Riviera for a month or two.
56.lessonText: He is a bachelor who lives in a fourth-storey luxury flat, so, if he feels like it, he can go off to the Riviera for a month or two.

clauses.text: He is a bachelor who lives in a fourth-storey luxury flat,
who lives in a fourth-storey luxury flat,
so, if he feels like it, he can go off to the Riviera for a month or two.
if he feels like it,

notes: who 修饰 bachelor。so 连接结果，if 插在第二主句前。feel like it 指想去旅行；it 是代词，不是不定式标记。

57.text: Next week he is flying to Japan on business in his private aeroplane, though people say he very much prefers travelling by train.
57.lessonText: Next week he is flying to Japan on business in his private aeroplane, though people say he very much prefers travelling by train.

clauses.text: Next week he is flying to Japan on business in his private aeroplane, though people say he very much prefers travelling by train.
though people say he very much prefers travelling by train.
he very much prefers travelling by train.

notes: is flying 配合 Next week 表已安排的将来。say 后省略 that；prefer 后接 travelling，在此不说明两种交通的正式比较结构。

58.text: He is said to have twenty-one suits, but he is always seen in the same old one.
58.lessonText: He is said to have twenty-one suits, but he is always seen in the same old one.

clauses.text: He is said to have twenty-one suits,
but he is always seen in the same old one.

notes: is said to have = people say he has。这里 have 是“拥有”，不是不定式完成式 to have done。one 代替 suit。
to have twenty-one suits 表示拥有，不是完成不定式；always 与被动谓语 is…seen 分开。

59.text: By the way, I remember now.
59.lessonText: By the way, I remember now.

clauses.text: By the way, I remember now.

notes: By the way 转入补充信息。remember 此处宾语由语境省略，不必硬找一个隐藏的 that 从句。

60.text: His father and mother are both Finns: Perhaps that is why he takes no interest in cricket.
60.lessonText: His father and mother are both Finns: Perhaps that is why he takes no interest in cricket.

clauses.text: His father and mother are both Finns:
Perhaps that is why he takes no interest in cricket.
why he takes no interest in cricket.

notes: 冒号连接解释性主句。that 指父母的背景；why 从句作表语。Perhaps 表示人物猜想，不能把国籍与个人兴趣说成确定因果。
将旧分析中错放在句首的 both 恢复到 are 后，与原文逐字对应；why… 为 Predicative clause，takes 是谓语，no interest 是宾语。

61.text: His real name is Jussi Saksalainen, but he is now a naturalised British subject with an English name.
61.lessonText: His real name is Jussi Saksalainen, but he is now a naturalised British subject with an English name.

clauses.text: His real name is Jussi Saksalainen,
but he is now a naturalised British subject with an English name.

notes: naturalised 为过去分词定语，修饰 subject。British subject 是原文的历史身份措辞；不延伸为当前法律解释。

62.text: He doesn't look at all Finnish.
62.lessonText: He doesn't look at all Finnish.

clauses.text: He doesn't look at all Finnish.

notes: look 后直接用形容词 Finnish，不需要 like。at all 加强否定；这又暴露了凭外观判断国籍的问题。

clauses.text: "Here's your other case.

notes: 展开为 Here is your other case，主语在 be 后。case 在此是行李箱，不是前文公文包必然同一物件。
Here’s 拆为前置地点副词 Here 与系动词 ’s；your other case 为后置主语。

64.text: Put it down a minute while I unlock the car.
64.lessonText: Put it down a minute while I unlock the car.

clauses.text: Put it down a minute while I unlock the car.
while I unlock the car.

notes: 主语 you 省略。代词 it 放 put 和 down 之间。a minute 为名词性时长状语；while 表同时进行。
Put…down 的小品词 down 与 Put 对应主句谓语色；while 从句内 unlock 用从句谓语色。

clauses.text: Do you enjoy gardening?

notes: enjoy 后接 -ing，不用 enjoy to garden；gardening 不是另一个限定谓语。

66.text: If so, you can help me: digging, weeding and mowing the lawn.
66.lessonText: If so, you can help me: digging, weeding and mowing the lawn.
functions: digging, weeding and mowing the lawn.

clauses.text: If so, you can help me: digging, weeding and mowing the lawn.
If so,

notes: If so 代替 if you enjoy gardening，未写出限定谓语；冒号后 -ing 列举帮助做的事，不是三个从句。
If so 为 Reduced conditional clause，so 回指 enjoy gardening；冒号后动名词列举具体工作，不标成有限定谓语。

67.text: And I'm painting the tool shed tomorrow.
67.lessonText: And I'm painting the tool shed tomorrow.

clauses.text: And I'm painting the tool shed tomorrow.

notes: 现在进行时表示已安排的将来活动。句首 And 接续前面的话，不使本条自动成为并列句。

68.text: You don't know how to play cricket yet, but I'm taking you to a match on Saturday.
68.lessonText: You don't know how to play cricket yet, but I'm taking you to a match on Saturday.

clauses.text: You don't know how to play cricket yet,
but I'm taking you to a match on Saturday.

notes: how to play 是疑问词＋不定式，并非限定从句。I'm taking 配合 on Saturday 表将来安排；两个主句由 but 连接。
how to play cricket 为嵌入疑问不定式补足，不增设 Object clause；I 与 ’m taking 拆开以保持谓语范围准确。

69.text: Can you speak English any better now?
69.lessonText: Can you speak English any better now?

clauses.text: Can you speak English any better now?

notes: any 在疑问句中修饰比较级 better，意为哪怕更好一点；不能把 any 当 English 的限定词。

70.text: You can soon lose that Finnish reserve.
70.lessonText: You can soon lose that Finnish reserve.

clauses.text: You can soon lose that Finnish reserve.

notes: reserve 是名词“拘谨”，不是预订座位的 reserve 动词。Finnish reserve 是角色的文化概括，应看出文章对刻板印象的反照。

clauses.text: Come along!

notes: 省略主语 you，但 come 为祈使句限定形式，可独立成句。此处催促义，与 Roommates 中“出现”义不同。

clauses.text: Let's get going!

notes: Let's = let us，提出共同建议；get going 表开始行动，不是两个限定主句。
Let 为祈使谓语，’s = us 为宾语，get going 为不带 to 的不定式宾语补足，不另加有限定谓语色。

clauses.text: I'm hungry and hot."

notes: and 连接两个形容词表语，不能据此归为并列句。

74.text: Matti remembers sadly all that his school-teachers say about his overactive and unreliable imagination.
74.lessonText: Matti remembers sadly all that his school-teachers say about his overactive and unreliable imagination.
functions: about his overactive and unreliable imagination.

clauses.text: Matti remembers sadly all that his school-teachers say about his overactive and unreliable imagination.
that his school-teachers say about his overactive and unreliable imagination.

notes: all 是代词性的宾语中心；that 在定语从句中作 say 的宾语。overactive 与 unreliable 修饰 imagination，不是两个从句。
that 从句修饰 all，that 在从句中作 say 的宾语。

75.text: Perhaps they are right after all.
75.lessonText: Perhaps they are right after all.

clauses.text: Perhaps they are right after all.

notes: they 指老师们。after all 在句末表示“终究、毕竟”，让结尾成为 Matti 对自己判断方式的反思。
